title: Turkey and Ham Croatian Wrap
description: A gluten-free twist on a classic wrap, this recipe combines the flavors of turkey, ham, and Croatian spices with a light and zesty wrap.
instructions: 1. Lay the wrap flat on a clean surface.
2. Spread the zesty spread evenly over the wrap, leaving a 1-inch border on either side.
3. Arrange the sliced turkey and ham on top of the spread.
4. Sprinkle the Croatian seasoning over the meat.
5. Add the shredded lettuce and sliced tomato on top.
6. Fold the bottom edge of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
7. Slice in half and serve immediately.
8. Serve with your favorite sides, such as a side salad or a bowl of soup.
9. Consider adding some pickled vegetables or a dollop of tzatziki sauce for extra flavor.
10. Enjoy your delicious and easy Turkish-inspired wrap!
